inspectedText: Authors explain two-path interference, a dark output, and object-induced changes. They describe a heralded single-photon experiment with a Michelson implementation and a deflecting mirror as the obstacle. Dark-output clicks demonstrate the effect, with finite leakage and unsuccessful outcomes.
